dialysis_devices.name: Dialysis cassette 10K, 3–12 mL
dialysis_devices.notes: The usual choice for a few millilitres of LNP going into storage buffer: float it in at least 200 volumes of buffer and change the buffer twice.

dialysis_devices.name: Dialysis cassette 20K, 0.5–3 mL
dialysis_devices.notes: Small screening batches; the larger pores clear ethanol and free lipid a little faster.

dialysis_devices.name: Dialysis float device 100K, 1–5 mL
dialysis_devices.notes: A tube that floats upright in the buffer. 100 kD also clears free RNA fragments, at some risk of losing the smallest particles.
